content.title: Where to watch Michigan vs. Arizona Final Four matchup for free tonight
content.text: Michigan Wolverines forward Yaxel Lendeborg (23) as Michigan basketball faces Tennessee in the Elite Eight at United Center in Chicago on Saturday, March 28 2026.MLive.comIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.comThe Michigan Wolverines and the Arizona Wildcats will face off in the Final Four this Saturday night, with the winner advancing to the national championship game. Fans can catch the must-see action on TBS and TruTV at 8:49 p.m. ET, with streaming options available through DirecTV Stream, Sling and HBO Max. Final Four Streaming OptionsWhat channel is Michigan vs. Arizona on?The Final Four matchup will be available on TBS and TruTV.Who are the announcers for the Final Four?Ian Eagle, Bill Raftery, Grant Hill and Tracy Wolfson will make up the broadcasting team for the Final Four. TBS/TruTV Streaming OptionsDirecTV Stream: DirecTV Stream offers TBS and TruTV as part of its Choice package, which comes with over 125 channels. This plan offers new customers a five-day free trial and $35 off the first month of their subscription. Sling: Sling has several monthly plans that offer TBS. Unlike other streaming services, however, Sling also offers day passes, starting at $4.99, for customers who are just looking to test out the service or watch a specific game. HBO Max: HBO Max’s standard plan offers customers access to live sports in addition to hundreds of hit TV shows and movies. How does Sling’s day pass work?Fans can score a one-day pass for $4.99, a three-day pass for $9.99 or a seven-day pass for $14.99. These passes are one time activations.NCAA TOURNAMENT FINAL FOURNo. 1 Michigan vs. No. 1 ArizonaWhen: Saturday, April 4, 2026Where: Lucas Oil Stadium, Indianapolis, Ind.
